entities.name: 2017 East Timorese presidential election
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Presidential elections were held in East Timor on 20 March 2017. Incumbent President Taur Matan Ruak, who was eligible for a second term, chose not to run for re-election. The result was a victory for Francisco Guterres of FRETILIN.
